stories.title: Malaysia PM Anwar orders probe after immigration truck crash in KL kills 3
stories.summary: Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim has ordered an immediate investigation after an Immigration Department truck crash in Kuala Lumpur killed three family members. The truck, with activated sirens, entered a red light and collided with a car, then hit four pedestrians, causing three deaths and one critical injury. Police detained both drivers and are investigating, while the Immigration Department will review procedures and cooperate fully with authorities. Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has ordered the country’s Immigration Department to immediately conduct a thorough investigation after an accident involving one of its trucks killed three members of a family on Aug 19. He said in a Facebook post on Aug 19 that action must be taken if the investigation finds any negligence or breach of the law. A man and his two daughters were killed after they were hit by an Immigration Department truck that veered off course following a collision at a traffic light intersection along Jalan Sultan Ismail in Kuala Lumpur. Kuala Lumpur Traffic Investigation and Enforcement Department chief Mohd Zamzuri Mohd Isa said the accident happened at about 1am, reported Sinar Harian. He said the truck was travelling without passengers from the Kuala Lumpur Immigration office to Chow Kit to pick up detainees following an operation against illegal immigrants in the area. “Initial investigations found that the truck, driven by a 43-year-old man, was believed to have entered the intersection while the traffic light in its direction was red, with its beacon lights and siren activated,” Assistant Commissioner Zamzuri said. “At the same time, a car driven by a 50-year-old man was travelling straight through the intersection as the traffic light in his direction was green. “The driver was unable to avoid the truck, resulting in a collision in the middle of the intersection.” Zamzuri said the impact caused the Immigration Department truck to veer towards four pedestrians, who were a family.
